title: SKYX Announces That, Based on Growing Winter Demand, It Will Launch 4 New Plug & Play Turbo Heater Fan Models in 5 Different Colors
body_markdown:
*Upcoming Winter Launches of New Models in Sizes of 20'' 44" 52" and 60" are Expected in Home Depot, Lowes, Target, Walmart, Amazon and on Company's E-Commerce Platform*


*Management Anticipates New Turbo Heater Models to Generate Significant Revenues During the Winter to Support Its Path to Cash-Flow Positive*


MIAMI, Nov. 04, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- SKYX Platforms Corp. (NASDAQ: SKYX) (the "Company" or "SKYX"), a highly disruptive platform technology company with over 120 patents and pending applications globally and 60 lighting and home décor websites, with a mission to make homes and buildings become safe and smart as the new standard, today announced that based on growing sales and winter demand for its patented all-in-one turbo heater ceiling fan, it will launch an additional four models in larger and smaller sizes 20" 44" 52" and 60" and in five different colors including white, black, brush nickel, gold, and bronze in addition to its original 24" model.


- The combined ceiling fan and portable heater category is a multi-billion-dollar market, with tens of millions of units sold annually in the U.S. alone.
- With the expansion of SKYX's Turbo Heater ceiling category, the Company expects to lead the ceiling heating category as well as the all-seasons ceiling fan category solution.
- As SKYX continues to grow its market penetration in both builder and retail channels this launch of additional models supports its growing Razor and Blades model for both builder and retail segments.
- Upcoming winter launches of new models in sizes of 20'' 44" 52" and 60" are expected to be available in Home Depot, Lowes, Target, Walmart, Amazon and on Company's e-commerce platform during the fourth quarter in five different colors including white, black, brush nickel, gold, and bronze.
- Company management anticipates new turbo heater models to generate significant revenues during the winter to support Company's path to cash-flow positive.
- Company maintains a strong cash position. Reported $27.7 million in total cash, cash equivalents, and restricted cash as of the end of the second quarter of 2026 and continues to maintain a strong cash position to achieve its business goals, including reaching positive cash flow as it exits 2026.
- SKYX's Turbo Heater ceiling Fan innovative product-integrating a ceiling fan with a built-in turbo heater-provides a safer solution to the space heater market and is designed to address a massive market opportunity for both winter and summer seasons.


**Rani Kohen, Founder, and Executive Chairman of SKYX Platforms Corp., stated:** *"* We are experiencing great winter demand for our turbo heater and ceiling fan from both retail and builder markets. This product exemplifies our commitment to innovation, safety, and global market products. As we prepare for our upcoming launch, we believe this all-in-one solution will drive significant value for our customers, partners, and shareholders.


For more information about SKYX and its significant Deako visit[www.SKYX.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=_DLCh8zdZ6AWTyx_NyvlU2KVgV2WcOIQiK2qbO3yAoSn-LjOBwLINY-poB-Gobt7KTQwtY_mMUbVSZBeOy2V_Q==) and[www.Deako.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=kEt5qaGNG0Kr8vr8dWrjs2PsEW_QTSHhlYb1c_QR2le3gFuqF0ZeIVa0RJwMyEP3JUYWioZqwRyvsOWP-y6Ezw==) .


**About SKYX Platforms Corp.**


As electricity is a standard in every home and building, our mission is to make homes and buildings become safe-advanced and smart as the new standard. SKYX has a series of highly disruptive advanced, safe, smart and AI platform technologies, with over 120 U.S. and global patents and patent pending applications. Additionally, the Company owns 60 lighting and home décor websites for both retail and commercial segments. Our technologies place an emphasis on high quality and ease of use, while significantly enhancing both safety and lifestyle in homes and buildings. We believe that our products are a necessity in every room in both homes and other buildings in the U.S. and globally. For more information, please visit our website at[https://www.skyx.com/](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=EKKFcUDPKCLrKfG3PodkQVNyYSvLTpfeg7oedQS_89QoGA4HzPq_s3gn5H17QQHh2ROpwTiiZN6S9aHdh-qfT27jVFnC78Vixh_Dc06s-jE=) or follow us on[LinkedIn](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=ACxEZpjX2jvphb-iMhNRVl6hu2zfaew6YI_9WHHf68SK2YmCmecjYGR496bAYw0lornB2KpNQEL1L4sspLTQI-IEr9Vla0FRovFzAk3kcuhGTLZOvhQFuU-n7WOubJsu) .
